text:
maria: Quick planning thread  need a launch post + 1-pg battlecard + webinar funnel that actually drives demos. Focus: 'serving economics' + reliability fallback story. Target webinar: 2024-06-10.
jon: Agreed. Hero stat should be simple: p95 latency delta + steady-state cost per token. One bold number in the hero.
pritam: I'll prep the benchmark appendix and a tiny methods note. We should avoid absolute multipliers unless infra signs off.
sophie-sdr: Routing ask: registrants -> if title contains "Head"/"CTO" OR company_size>300 -> AE_queue; EU -> EU_SDR; else SDR_nurture. Need 2 email templates & 30s call script.
design-bot: Uploaded slide mock + chart templates: https://designs.redwood/serve-econ/mock1.png
maria: Copy direction: less infra-speak, more econ: "Lower unit cost, predictable latency, enterprise controls". Keep subhead under 10 words.
jon: Webinar demo idea: 5m live compare (p95 over time) + 3 business takeaways. Recorded clip for SDRs to use.
pritam: Verified test rig: 8-GPU baseline, mixed seqs, synthetic workload + real traces. I'll attach CSV once infra confirms.
sophie-sdr: Objection bullets for battlecard (one-liners): 1) "We already run on cloud": "Cloud gives compute; Redwood gives serving predictability and fallbacks." 2) "We value single vendor": "We integrate with your infra and give safer rollouts." 3) "Cost is unpredictable": "We show unit economics and autoscaling levers."
maria: Good — tighten language and make bullets scannable.
jon: For the launch post headline idea: "Predictable inference economics, same API." Subhead: "Lower unit cost, consistent latency, enterprise-grade controls."
pritam: I'll provide a short methodology blurb for the appendix: hardware, seq distribution, batching policy. Keep it 2-3 lines.
sophie-sdr: HubSpot pseudo-rule I'll implement:
```
if role in ["CTO","Head of ML","Platform"] or company_size >= 300 -> assign "AE_queue"
else if lead_score >= 70 -> assign "SDR_priority"
else -> assign "nurture_sequence"
```
jon: Add tags: #enterprise #gdpr-eu #regulated. EU leads get 24h SLA. Regulated industries flagged for SE follow-up re: private deploy.
design-bot: Also uploaded a 6-slide webinar deck skeleton: https://designs.redwood/serve-econ/deck_v1.pdf
maria: Owners: post = jon, battlecard = pritam + jon copy, emails & SDR playbook = sophie-sdr, visuals = design. Check-in 48h.
pritam: First draft benchmark CSV link (pending infra sign-off): https://storage.redwood/bench/serve-econ-jun2024.csv
sophie-sdr: I'll draft the two email templates and a 3-bullet discovery script for the hands-off AEs. ETA EOD tomorrow.
jon: Tone reminder: customer-facing, econ-first, avoid "infrastructure bragging". Keep CTA options: "Request dedicated trial" and "Schedule performance audit".
maria: Thanks team. I'll compile copy and a short launch checklist and drop in Notion. :sparkles:
